zh.title: 空中巴士A350F貨機傳最快9月首飛 拼2027年底投入營運
zh.summary: 空中巴士A350F貨機傳最快2026年9月首飛；目標2027年底前投入營運。
body: 根據業界消息人士與相關報導，飛機製造商空中巴士（Airbus）正爭取最早於2026年9月讓旗下最新款A350F雙引擎廣體貨機進行首次飛行。消息指出，相關試飛日程仍有可能視作業進度微調，並推遲至10月初進行。空中巴士官方發言人對相關報導日程則拒絕發表評論。
空中巴士計畫在A350F完成首飛後，展開至少為期12個月的認證測試程序，以達成於2027年底前將該型貨機正式投入營運服務的既定目標。認證測試是該機型進入商業運作前的重要里程碑，製造商正全力推進相關進度，確保營運時程得以如期實現。
在性能規格方面，A350F貨機基於空中巴士熱銷的A350客機平台開發，設計最大載重能力達111公噸，航程可達8,700公里。該機型選用勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）Trent XWB-97發動機，結構採用逾70%先進材料，相較於同等載重與航程的舊款貨機，可降低高達20%的燃油消耗與碳排放，並在投入營運時即具備最高50%永續航空燃料（SAF）的混合使用能力。

截至目前，空中巴士已累計取得來自全球十餘家客戶、共計107架A350F貨機的確認訂單。主要客戶包括簽署20架訂單的美國貨運航空 Atlas Air、訂購10架的台灣星宇航空（STARLUX Airlines）、訂購10架的中國貨運航空與阿提哈德航空（Etihad Airways）、訂購8架的國泰集團，以及大韓航空（Korean Air）與亞塞拜然絲路西航空（Silk Way West Airlines）等業者。

en.title: Airbus Targets A350F Maiden Flight as Soon as September Ahead of 2027 Entry Target
en.summary: Airbus targets the A350F freighter maiden flight in September 2026, aiming for 2027 entry into service.
body: According to industry sources and published reports, European aircraft manufacturer Airbus is targeting the maiden flight of its new A350F twin-engine widebody freighter as early as September 2026. Industry sources indicated that the initial test flight schedule remains subject to operational progress and could potentially slip into early October 2026. An official spokesperson for Airbus declined to comment on the reported maiden flight timeline.

Airbus aims to achieve full commercial entry into service for the A350F freighter by the end of 2027 following its maiden flight. The certification flight-testing pathway is expected to take at least 12 months to complete, placing operational pressure on the manufacturer to launch flight testing promptly to meet its established 2027 deadline.

Developed on the popular A350 passenger aircraft platform, the A350F freighter is designed to carry a maximum payload of up to 111 tonnes over non-stop distances of up to 8,700 kilometres. Powered by Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines and incorporating over 70 percent advanced materials by weight, the freighter is expected to consume up to 20 percent less fuel and generate 20 percent lower carbon emissions compared to previous-generation freighters, while maintaining compatibility with up to 50 percent sustainable aviation fuel blends from entry into service.

Airbus has accumulated a total of 107 firm orders for the A350F freighter from more than a dozen airline and freight customers worldwide. Principal customers for the new widebody freighter include US freight carrier Atlas Air with 20 aircraft, Taiwan-based STARLUX Airlines with 10 aircraft, Air China Cargo and Etihad Airways with 10 aircraft each, Hong Kong's Cathay Group with 8 aircraft, South Korea's Korean Air with 7 aircraft, and Silk Way West Airlines with 4 aircraft.

zh.title: 西銳 Vision Jet 於愛達荷州跑道起飛撞擊施工材料導致起落架塌陷
zh.summary: 一架西銳 Vision Jet 於德里格斯起飛時撞擊施工材料，起落架塌陷致1傷。
body: 一架西銳 Vision Jet（Cirrus Vision Jet）私人噴射機在美國愛達荷州德里格斯-里德紀念機場（DIJ）嘗試起飛時，進入因施工而封閉的跑道區域並發生碰撞，導致飛機起落架塌陷且機體嚴重受損。地方政府證實，機上一名乘客在事故中受傷，隨後由救護車送往當地醫院接受治療。
根據德里格斯市官方發布的詳細資訊，該起事故發生於2026年8月14日當地時間上午6時30分左右，當時該架 Vision Jet 正在嘗試從04跑道起飛。作為機場施工計畫的一部分，原本總長7,301英呎的跑道已有部分區域封閉數週，當時僅剩餘3,850英呎的長度供起飛使用。
德里格斯市副行政官道格·賽爾夫（Doug Self）在聲明中表示，該飛機進入封閉區域並試圖穿越正在施工的跑道段。飛行員在接近施工現場時雖能降低機速，但仍無法避免撞擊現場的營建材料。美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）補充指出，該飛機在施工區域撞擊碎石，進而造成起落架塌陷。
根據 FAA 的登記紀錄，該架國籍標誌暨登記號碼為 N71KD 的飛機，登記所有人為總部設於馬里蘭州切維蔡斯的 Vision71 Technologies。機場官員說明，德里格斯-里德紀念機場屬於無管制塔台機場，在工程開工前數週即已向飛行員通知施工計畫，並於8月5日發布飛航通告（NOTAM）。
該份飛航通告明確指出，04/22跑道西南側的3,451英呎區域將封閉至9月5日，04跑道的可用起飛滑跑距離、可用起飛距離及可用加速停止距離均為3,850英呎。主管機關目前尚未說明該飛機為何進入跑道封閉區域，亦未證實飛行員是否知悉相關飛航限制，受傷乘客的具體傷勢狀況則尚未對外公開。

en.title: Cirrus Vision Jet Suffers Gear Collapse on Closed Runway in Idaho
en.summary: A Cirrus Vision Jet suffered gear collapse during a closed-runway takeoff in Idaho, injuring one passenger.
body: A Cirrus Vision Jet sustained substantial damage and suffered a landing gear collapse during a takeoff attempt from a closed runway section at Driggs-Reed Memorial Airport (DIJ (DIJ)) in Idaho. Official statements confirm that one passenger on board was injured in the collision and was subsequently transported by ambulance to a local hospital for medical evaluation.

According to details released by the City of Driggs, the accident occurred at approximately 06:30 local time on August 14, 2026, as the Vision Jet attempted to depart from Runway 4. A section of the airport's primary 7,301-foot runway had been closed for several weeks as part of an ongoing airport construction project, leaving an available takeoff distance of 3,850 feet.

City authorities reported that the aircraft entered the closed area and attempted to take off through the portion of the runway under construction. Driggs Deputy City Administrator Doug Self stated that while the pilot was able to slow the plane upon approaching the construction site, a collision with construction materials could not be averted. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) added that the jet struck gravel on the closed section, resulting in the collapse of its landing gear.

FAA records identify the aircraft by registration N71KD, registered to Vision71 Technologies based in Chevy Chase, Maryland. Airport officials noted that Driggs-Reed Memorial Airport operates as a non-towered facility and that pilots had been advised of the construction work several weeks prior to the start of the project. A formal Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) outlining the partial runway closure was officially issued on August 5.

The issued NOTAM specified that the southwest 3,451 feet of Runway 04/22 would remain closed through September 5, leaving 3,850 feet of takeoff run, takeoff distance, and accelerate-stop distance available for Runway 04 operations. Aviation investigators and local authorities have not determined why the aircraft entered the closed construction area or whether the pilot was aware of the active NOTAM restrictions. The extent of the injured passenger's condition has not been disclosed.

zh.title: FlyDubai恢復飛越伊朗領空 儘管EASA警告
zh.summary: FlyDubai恢復飛越伊朗領空；稱經安全檢查節省成本
body: 簡單飛行（Simple Flying）報導標題為「Major UAE Carrier Resumes Flights Over Iranian Airspace Despite EASA Warnings Not To」，內容指出阿聯酋主要航空公司FlyDubai已恢復飛越伊朗領空的航班，此舉無視歐洲航空安全局（EASA）先前發出的警告。
報導另稱，FlyDubai發出訊號：「FlyDubai signals tangible savings for passengers and operations with shorter routes and lower emissions after detailed safety checks。」表示完成詳細安全檢查後，縮短航線將為乘客與營運帶來實質節省，並降低排放。

en.title: FlyDubai Resumes Flights Over Iranian Airspace Despite EASA Warnings
en.summary: FlyDubai resumes Iran overflights despite EASA warnings; claims savings and emissions cuts after safety checks
body: Simple Flying reported under the headline "Major UAE Carrier Resumes Flights Over Iranian Airspace Despite EASA Warnings Not To" that UAE carrier FlyDubai has resumed flights over Iranian airspace, disregarding prior warnings from the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA).

The report added that FlyDubai signaled: "FlyDubai signals tangible savings for passengers and operations with shorter routes and lower emissions after detailed safety checks," indicating that after detailed safety checks, shorter routes would deliver tangible savings for passengers and operations while reducing emissions.
The resumption comes after FlyDubai conducted detailed safety checks, according to the report.

zh.title: 空中巴士合成飞机加入德国空军演习夏季
zh.summary: 德国空军演习中实战部队与虚拟对手及合成飞机同演夏季2026
body: 空中巴士在2026年夏季的德国空军“蒂姆表演”演习中，将合成飞机与真实部队同演，使欧罗卡特和图伦多机组与虚拟盟友及电脑生成威胁并肩作战，展示了在真实作战环境下使用模拟资产进行战术训练的可行性，并强化了部队的联网作战能力，同时该演习旨在测试实时作战数据交换并评估新型无人系统的性能，确保作战效能在不暴露敏感战术的前提下得到提升。
空中巴士系统开发实验室（SDL）被连接至现场训练环境，将虚拟资产与实战单位融合，雷内·比尔霍尔茨表示SDL作为“构造性引擎”，能够整合模拟资产与现场力量，显著降低空域填充成本并使尚未投入使用的系统得以测试，同时保持敏感战术不被公众知晓，为未来的无人作战平台提供了关键技术支撑。
作为未来十年内将进入服役的无人协同作战飞机的典型案例，U740“Valkyrie”无人作战飞机预计将在2029年前为德国空军提供主权无人作战能力，同时SDL试验支持德国更广泛地将欧罗卡特与无人作战平台联网，推动空中作战网络的构建并提升整体作战效能。
这些发展体现了德国推动空中力量现代化的战略，通过将装备载人战斗机与下一代无人系统相结合，旨在维持空中优势并通过有韧性的作战云架构提升整体空中作战韧性与灵活性。
将合成资产引入现场训练不仅加速技术成熟速度，还为德国空军提供成本效益高的方式，使其能够在真实情境中演练复杂场景、评估数据链性能并精炼指挥控制程序，从而强化 NATO 互操作性并提升整体空域韧性。

en.title: Airbus integrates synthetic aircraft into live German Air Force Timber Express
en.summary: Airbus inserts synthetic aircraft into German Air Force; German Eurofighter and Tornado crews train with virtual allies
body: Airbus announced that its synthetic aircraft were incorporated into the German Air Force’s Timber Express exercise held during the summer of 2026, enabling Eurofighter and Tornado crews to operate together with virtual allies and computer‑generated threat simulations in a realistic combat environment. The scenario allowed participants to evaluate tactics, test emerging technologies, and maintain operational security while experiencing the dynamics of live‑air combat.

The Airbus System Development Lab (SDL) was linked to the live training environment, inserting synthetic aircraft and simulated threats into the same operational scenario as real units, and Business Developer René Birkholz explained that the SDL functions as a “constructive engine,” integrating simulated assets with live forces to lower airspace expenditure, permit testing of future systems before fielding, and keep sensitive tactics concealed from public scrutiny.

An example highlighted was the U740 Valkyrie unmanned collaborative combat aircraft, expected to enter service by the end of the decade, providing Germany with a sovereign unmanned platform that complements the Eurofighter fleet and supports the broader goal of integrating manned and unmanned capabilities within a networked combat cloud.

These developments reflect Germany’s strategic push to modernize its air power by linking manned fighter aircraft with next‑generation unmanned systems, aiming to sustain air superiority and operational flexibility through a resilient combat cloud architecture.

The integration of synthetic assets into live training not only accelerates technology maturation but also provides a cost‑effective means for the Luftwaffe to rehearse complex scenarios, evaluate data‑link performance, and refine command‑and‑control procedures, thereby strengthening NATO interoperability and overall air domain resilience.

The exercise demonstrates that synthetic training can complement traditional flight operations, offering a scalable platform for testing new weapons, sensors, and network protocols while preserving the confidentiality of operational concepts.
